Middleton, Jr. and Tom F. Phillips., Chapman L. Sanford argued the cause for appellee. With him on the briefs were John B. Smullin and Emmett E. Batson. Briefs of amici curiae, in support of appellant, were filed by Cicero C. Sessions for Sperry Rand Corp.; Forrest M. Darrough for Humble Oil & Refining Co.; Charles D. Marshall for Thomas Jordan, Inc.; Albert L. Hopkins for Chicago Bridge & Iron Co.; Ben R. Miller for American Can Co.; and Robert E. Leake, Jr. for Ros-son-Richards Processing Co. et al.
